title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic launched **Claude Fable 5**, its first publicly available **"Mythos-class"** model — a new capability tier above the standard Haiku/Sonnet/Opus line. Alongside it, Anthropic introduced **Claude Mythos 5**, the same underlying model with certain safety guardrails lifted for specific vetted use cases.

---

## Claude Fable 5: Capabilities

Fable 5 achieves state-of-the-art performance on nearly all benchmarks Anthropic tested it against, spanning software engineering, knowledge work, vision, and scientific research. Anthropic notes a distinctive pattern: **the longer and more complex the task, the larger Fable 5's lead** over other models — suggesting particular strength in long-horizon agentic work rather than short single-turn tasks.

**Safety approach:** Fable 5 ships with safeguards that redirect certain sensitive queries to Claude Opus 4.8 instead of answering directly. Anthropic reports these safeguards trigger in fewer than 5% of sessions on average, meaning the vast majority of ordinary usage is unaffected.

---

## Claude Mythos 5: A Restricted Sibling

Claude Mythos 5 is the same base model as Fable 5, but with safeguards lifted in specific areas. It was initially deployed only through **Project Glasswing**, a collaboration with the US government, and Anthropic describes it as having the strongest cybersecurity capabilities of any model it has built — useful for vetted defensive security work, but also carrying higher misuse potential.

---

## The Export Control Episode

Fable 5's rollout was interrupted by a brief regulatory dispute:

- **June 9, 2026:** Fable 5 becomes generally available on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry.
- **June 12, 2026:** The US government applies export controls to the model, requiring restrictions on access by foreign nationals. Because Anthropic could not verify user nationality in real time, it suspended access for *all* users globally as a precaution.
- **June 30, 2026:** After a series of conversations with the US government, the export controls are lifted.
- **July 1, 2026:** Anthropic begins redeploying Fable 5 globally, adding a new set of classifiers specifically to detect and block cybersecurity-related misuse, while leaving routine tasks like coding unaffected.

This marked one of the first instances of a frontier US AI lab having a model's availability directly paused by government export-control action, then restored after negotiation.

---

## Pricing and Availability

Both Fable 5 and Mythos 5 are priced at **$10 per million input tokens** and **$50 per million output tokens** — less than half the price of the earlier Claude Mythos Preview. Model ID: `claude-fable-5`.

Available on: Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry.

---

## How It Fits the Model Lineup

Fable 5 sits above the Haiku/Sonnet/Opus tiers rather than replacing them — Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 4.5 remain Anthropic's mainstream, widely-deployed models, while Fable 5 targets the most demanding long-horizon and research-grade workloads. See [Claude Model History](claude-model-history) for how it relates to the rest of the lineup.
